class.name: OpenXRSpatialImageTrackingCapability
class.brief_description: Implementation for handling spatial entity image tracking logic.
class.description: This class handles the OpenXR image tracking spatial entity extension.

method.name: get_built_in_tracking_state
method.description: Returns the state of the built-in tracking system.

method.name: image_database_add
method.description: Adds an image to an image tracking database. [param name] sets a name for this image, this will be set on our [OpenXRImageTracker] object when this image is detected. [param image] is the image we track, this should be an uncompressed RGB or RGBA image. [param physical_width] provides an indicator of how wide the image is in reality. If [param is_static] is [code]true[/code] the tracking logic assume the image will not be moved after it has been detected.

method.name: image_database_create
method.description: Create an image tracking database. This database will hold a collection of images that the image tracking logic will be able to detect.

method.name: image_database_free
method.description: Clean up an image tracking database. [b]Note:[/b] If the image database is still in use this will give an error.

method.name: image_database_submit
method.description: Uploads the image tracking database to OpenXR. This must be called before the image database is used to create a spatial context. Once called the image database can no longer be modified. [param user_callback] is an optional method that will be called if submission has been successful. It will have the image database RID as a parameter. [param fail_callback] is called if submitting our image database fails, The parameters are respectively the image database RID, the failure code (integer), and a boolean that indicates if the failure was in retrieving the image tracking database handle. [b]Note:[/b] If we fail to start submitting our image database, no [OpenXRFutureResult] object is returned and neither callbacks are called.

method.name: is_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if image tracking is supported.

method.name: start_built_in_tracking
method.description: Starts our built in image tracking using the supplied image tracking database.

method.name: start_entity_discovery
method.description: Performs discovery of our images. This is called automatically if our built in image tracking is enabled.

method.name: stop_built_in_tracking
method.description: Stops out built in image tracking.
